supersedes.note: Pre-0731 release. NO LOCAL ROLLBACK PATH EXISTS. The *.gguf.pre0731 anchors were deleted at owner instruction on 2026-08-09; an earlier version of this note claimed they remained and were a tested rollback target, which was true when written and is not true now. Rollback requires re-fetching this repo/revision from HuggingFace. The per-shard sha256 values needed to verify such a re-fetch are preserved in the git history of weights/unsloth-ud-q2_k_xl/manifest.json at commit 72d1db7^. No rollback has ever been executed or verified end-to-end.
supersedes.unrelated_stale_copies: Two full pre-0731 copies exist under /var/lib/dsv4-context/models/ (90.18 GiB each, root-owned, link count 1). They are NOT a rollback path: they are the context-qualification protected model copy and its rotated-aside predecessor, they are unreadable and unwritable from the harness account, and scripts/64_context_submit.sh will replace the live one from the 0731 weights on its next run. See results/dsv4-0731-staging/thinking-default-and-disk-2026-08-09.json.
